title: Tissenum - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Tissenum in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Tissenum is a earth-element weapon used by Maelle. It scales with Agility (C), Vitality (B).

sections.title: How to Get the Tissenum
sections.content:
Location: Sirene - Tisseur drop.

Obtained from Sirene - Tisseur drop.

sections.title: Is the Tissenum Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Agility (C), Vitality (B). A dedicated earth pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
